title: GPT-4 Technical Report
before: GPT-3.5 was the deployed frontier, text only, and error-prone on hard reasoning.
problem: How far could the recipe be pushed, and could performance be predicted before training?
breakthrough: A large capability jump with image input, and infrastructure that predicted final performance from small-scale runs.
why: It set the bar every other lab measured against for over a year, and its outputs trained much of the open ecosystem.
next: GPT-4V added vision publicly, GPT-4 Turbo added context, then GPT-4o unified modalities.
inherits: Predictable scaling as an engineering discipline, and multimodal input as standard.
